blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Fog forests, redwood groves, cloud forests, forest-edge succession, and landscapes where distance disappears behind mist and vegetation before it physically ends.
World relation: Quiet and Wild traditions. The forest protects life from constant observation while allowing attention and relationship to create local clarity.
Connection to newer locations: It connects to the Redwood Rain Vault, Cloudroot Tepuis, Bamboo Signal Sea, Blackwater Canopy, and Inverted Rainforest.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Unobserved does not mean nonexistent. A place can refuse complete rendering without being empty, broken, or waiting only for a player to make it real.
